title: Orbis 2: A Hierarchical World Model for Driving
abstract: arXiv:2607.15898v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current world models operate at a single level of abstraction, with most prioritizing perceptual fidelity while lacking the spatial reasoning and semantic understanding required for real-world downstream tasks. We present a hierarchical driving world model that factorizes future prediction across two levels operating at distinct temporal and abstraction scales: a high-level predictor that forecasts coarse scene structure over extended temporal horizons, and a low-level generator that produces detailed predictions conditioned on the high-level output. translated_title: Orbis 2：面向自动驾驶的分层世界模型
translated_abstract: 当前世界模型在单一的抽象层级上运行，大多数模型优先追求感知保真度，却缺乏真实世界下游任务所需的空间推理与语义理解能力。我们提出了一种分层的驾驶世界模型，将未来预测分解为在各自不同的时间尺度和抽象尺度上运行的两个层级：一个高层预测器，用于在较长的时间范围内预测粗略的场景结构；一个低层生成器，以高层输出为条件生成细致的预测。这种分解方式在实现高感知保真度的同时，还能捕获强大的空间与语义表征。我们进一步表明，采用扩散强迫目标进行预训练，能够产生比标准教师强迫目标远为丰富的内部表征；而教师强迫——仅从干净的上下文预测下一帧——则能产生更稳定的自回归（生成）。
tldr: 该论文提出Orbis 2，一种将未来预测分解为“高层场景结构预测器+低层细节生成器”两个抽象层级的分层驾驶世界模型，并证明扩散强迫预训练目标比教师强迫能学到更丰富的内部表征。
en_tdlr: Orbis 2 is a hierarchical driving world model that factorizes future prediction into a high-level coarse scene structure predictor and a low-level detail generator, and shows that pretraining with a diffusion forcing objective yields substantially richer internal representations than teacher forcing.
